description: The angles in use across every tracked brand in the trailing window: the same shape as sightglass_find_angles, with the brand on each. Filter by angle type, the age band or awareness stage of the persona it speaks to, and sort by ads, landing pages or newest. Use it for 'what pitches are brands using on this audience' and to find an angle nobody is running. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_top_angles
title: Find angles across brands
